name: hk-gnss-pride
description: Download Hong Kong SatRef RINEX and run validated PRIDE PPP-AR atmospheric processing.

interface.shortDescription: Download SatRef RINEX and run PRIDE PPP-AR.
interface.longDescription: A portable workflow for downloading Hong Kong SatRef RINEX 3 observations, running PRIDE PPP-AR with VMF3 and stochastic tropospheric parameters, and validating atmospheric outputs.
defaultPrompt: Download and process Hong Kong GNSS data for a UTC date range.
Resume PRIDE processing using existing RINEX files.
Validate my PRIDE ZTD and horizontal-gradient outputs.
